title: A blueprint creates agent identities with accountable access
text:
DICE JOURNEY · MICROSOFT SHOWCASE
03 / 09
A blueprint creates agent identities with accountable access

Microsoft Entra issues the access token. JWT is its signed format; the gateway validates it.

Token holder
AKS ServiceAccount → blueprint
Child Agent ID
Dedicated SRE agent identity
Gateway → MCP
JWT + identity + role + tool

Inbound: calling app / UAMI → A2A API token → named agent

Outbound: blueprint exchange → child MCP API token → named tools

Microsoft Entra access token = signed JWT · child identity carries the agent permission
